scope: Independent original-execution reference of the cold-boot Retire Restore route continued past the 0x124548 entry through Restore construction, the scan of an isolated empty research memory card, the ready empty-slot UI, one ordinary Cancel, window death, manager unlink, resource retirement, wrapper cleanup and free, the mode request back to the title and the return of the second 0x12c350(selector 1).

play.tree_cleanliness: not verified (git on the Play checkout is outside the isolated worktree)

oracle.mode: --restore-cancel --memcards DIR (the Retire --title-retire restore observer; Restore hooks armed at the 0x124548 entry); --restore-cancel --memcards DIR --minimal for the control

current_time_audit.note: recomputed when this manifest was written; establishes the files present now, not historical reads

card_setup.rule: per run a fresh EVIDENCE/cards/<run>/{mc0,mc1}, created empty by tools/restore_capture.sh; the oracle refuses a non-empty or symlinked card, sets Play ps2.mc0/mc1.directory.v2 to them and lists them before and after the run; no user card or save directory is referenced

run_time_provenance.note: from the runs themselves (run-meta.json, memcards-*.json, disc-opens.jsonl)

fixed_settings.pad: ScriptedPad: neutral sticks; Retire restore title script; then Circle at the first 0x11e480 entry with state 0x21c and the input gate open (opacity == *0x24ecc4, != 0), released at the return of the call that consumed it (0x21c -> -1)
fixed_settings.stop: RETURN of the second 0x12c350(selector 1) (0x11528c), before its first 0x1296f8

commands: OKAGE_PLAY_VM_LOCK=<main>/local/research/.play-vm.lock tools/restore_capture.sh <evidence>/bin/okage-startup-oracle "<main>/local/disc/Okage - Shadow King (USA).cue" <main>/local/extracted/SCUS_971.29 <evidence> fill00-a:00: fill00-b:00: fillff-a:ff: fillff-b:ff: control-minimal-fill00:00:--restore-cancel+--minimal regress-retire-restore:00:--title-retire+restore regress-title:00:--title regress-default:00:default
evidence_dir: local/research/restore-original-v1 (read-only after capture; trials/ holds the development runs of earlier observer builds, not used by the analysis)
limitations: Play research backend, not hardware; vblank numbers and the traversal at which card readiness is observed are observer-dependent (control: 510->530->540 at calls 1/2/5 minimal vs 1/3/7 hooked), so per-traversal RNG draw counts before readiness differ between observer configurations; Cancel-to-death (32 traversals), the call count to the stop, every resource state and VRAM are observer-independent in the control
null renderer: draw-written nibbles are conservative ledger rectangles; no image or audio is captured
the observer keeps one hooked-frame stack across EE threads (the card thread interleaves); attribution uses call sites, not that stack
probes are block-start breakpoints: a probe never reported is "not observed", not "not reached"
